svg.text: END VIEW from the connector face
6 x VENT SLOT 3 x 24 IN FLOOR
LEDGE 2.0 WIDE. TOP AT Z 7.5 FROM OUTER BASE = 5.0 ABOVE INTERNAL FLOOR
carrier underside Z7.5 (5.0 above internal floor)
END ELEVATION (connector face, viewed from the right)
HEIGHT DATUMS Z=0 IS THE OUTER UNDERSIDE OF THE BASE
carrier underside, ledge top = 5.0 above floor
1. Lid screw bosses are OUTSIDE the cavity by design. Anything inside
it fouls the carrier, which fills the cavity.
2. Lid carries a hold-down rib on the carrier's free left edge plus four
pads, all stopping 1.5 above the board. Fit 1.5 EVA foam to each -
3. Lid: 3.4 clearance with 6.2 counterbore, over 4.0 inserts in the base.
4. LED window 18 x 12 in lid, thinned to 0.6, over the DevKitC RGB LED.
5. Gland replaces the 13 x 10 slot of the earlier model. M12 thread,
12.5 clearance hole, locknut supplied. Cable range 3.0 - 6.5.
6. Headroom above the DB9 is 4.8. Removing the DB9 buys only 2.5,
because the DC-DC is next at 23.2.
7. No lid seal and no breather vent this iteration. Sealing without a
vent is worse than leaving it unsealed.
